answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the ivory check immediately, the terrace audit keeps the resolved set and the pulse replay exposes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 294 aliases hence pays the reading cost 294 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
